environment: WSL2 Ubuntu 22.04, OpenJDK 11, Gradle 6.4.1 wrapper, headless AWT
build_patch: Removed only RViz/rosjava visualization dependencies (retired jcenter com.springsource artifacts blocked compile).

run_note: Official example intentionally starts three infinite mission-dispatch threads; the 120 s run was stopped by timeout after repeated missions, not by a crash.
observed: Three robots placed, missions dispatched, critical sections/dependencies updated, trajectories tracked and reparked; no Java exception in 1,776 log lines.
